description: A shell script containing a series of tests for Git's partial clone functionality, including setup, validation, and scenarios involving objects, packfiles, and remotes.

methods.name: delete_object
methods.description: Removes a Git object from the repository, given a directory and object hash.

methods.name: pack_as_from_promisor
methods.description: Creates a packfile from a promisor remote, capturing its object hash.

methods.name: promise_and_delete
methods.description: Creates a commit or tag, then promises it by packing, and deletes the original object.

methods.name: repack_and_check
methods.description: Repacks the repository and verifies that certain objects are present or absent.
